purpose: Close the three fixable gaps in one pass, and regression-test the PLs carve-out.

changes.PLs: MSm carve-out bound at L3 and L5. Diagnosis: on 12 of 36 battery items PLs judges disagreed by 2+, and 8 of those are haiku scoring 3-5 where sonnet and opus both score 0-1, on items registered MSc>=4. The routing existed only in the boundaries paragraph, which r32 showed does not bind.

hypotheses.H1_primary_factor_PLp: A1->A2 (search size up, everything else fixed) raises PLp by >=2. A1->A3 (volume up 40x, search still trivial) does NOT raise PLp.
hypotheses.H2_primary_factor_PLe: B1->B2 (feedback removed) raises PLe by >=2. B1->B3 (ten times the steps, feedback unchanged) does NOT raise PLe.
hypotheses.H3_primary_factor_PLs: C1->C2 raises PLs by >=3 while the amount of state falls from forty rooms to one. This is the sharp test of 'how hidden, not how much'.
hypotheses.H4_PLp_not_social: D1 (one thing to offer, no search) scores PLp <=1 while D2 (dozens of splits, most unworkable) scores PLp >=3. If both fire, PLp is responding to sociality and needs the same carve-out PLe and PLs have; if only D2 fires, PLp is correct and the battery's registration of 0 was too strict.
hypotheses.H5_X06R: The replacement co-occurrence item scores PLs >=4 AND MSc >=4, where the old X06 could not because its hidden state was entirely mental.
hypotheses.H6_no_regression: battery-v1 separation stays at 10/12 or better and PLs's judge disagreement falls.
